images.prompt: A quiet stone arch bridge spanning a narrow canal beside a small pale ochre house and a green willow tree, viewed obliquely in soft daylight. Photorealistic camera photograph of a fictional independently generated scene. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280 or larger. Natural material and light. No artwork, text, brands, logos, borders or watermark.

review.reason: The stone arch and canal opening are coherent; the ochre house, green shutters and willow are clearly visible with natural material textures and reflections.

images.actual_source_analysis: A low single-arch stone footbridge spans a narrow green canal diagonally across the middle. A pale ochre two-story house with muted green shutters, flower boxes and a wooden door stands at left. Long willow branches descend from the upper right; stone banks and soft reflections lead into the foreground canal. No people, signage or lettering.

Keep: Compress observed architecture and vegetation into connected stamp shapes while preserving bridge openings and the original left-right arrangement. Apply only the stated transformation; never treat the sample prompt as facts about a different user input.
Translate the observed landscape into a hand-pressed rubber stamp impression with broken ink coverage on clean fibrous paper.
Simplify the skyline, paths and major landmarks into connected stamp silhouettes and reserved paper openings.
Use imperfect ink transfer, slightly softened edges and small pressure gaps; avoid carved woodgrain and sculptural relief.

Frame the impression with one irregular rounded stamp boundary, without fabricated place names or dates.
